_readme: Paste IDs here and run `python build.py`. Blank = tag not emitted. Cloudflare token: dash.cloudflare.com > Analytics & Logs > Web Analytics > Add site > copy the token from the snippet. Google: Search Console > Add property (URL prefix https://toolboxtop10.com/) > HTML tag > copy the content="..." value. Bing: Webmaster Tools > Add site > HTML Meta Tag > copy the content value (or just import from Search Console and skip this).
